en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a staged theatrical scene inside an ornate paneled room with carved wooden doors and painted heraldic murals on the upper walls. At the right, an older, pale-faced man in evening dress leans over a fainting or swooning woman in a long dark gown who reclines on a sofa or chaise. At the left there is a table with tall candlesticks and an elaborate carved chair or throne. The image has no visible printed caption or border text on the front.
